verdict: Caution: lend selectively to value-added dairy and frozen-food processors with contracted offtake and tight monthly stock-and-receivable reporting; avoid commodity edible-oil and gherkin traders whose margins ride on raw-material swings.
title: Sri City Food Processing: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**Food processing here is a conversion business: buy farm output, chill or freeze it fast, and sell it before it spoils.** Cash is made on throughput and mix, not on price. Raw material is the largest cost line for FMCG firms, so any price swing hits margin directly [8]. Rating reports on gherkin and edible-oil processors show the same two levers: agro-climatic yield and government policy on agri trade [9][10]. **So when a proposal lands, check the offtake contract and the raw-material sourcing map first; if either is verbal, ask for the written agreement and the last two seasons' procurement invoices.**

## Where value and cash sit
**Value sits in branded, value-added lines; cash sits in the working-capital cycle.** Milky Mist's Q2 FY27 revenue rose 42% to Rs 1,089.4 crore with EBITDA margin at 15.17% versus 13.95%, on value-added dairy mix [4][5]. Dodla's Q2 FY27 revenue was Rs 1,196 crore, up 17.4%, but EBITDA margin was only 5.4% and packaging material costs rose 41.6% [6]. **That gap is the whole credit story: branded mix earns margin, commodity liquid milk does not.** Foods & Inns shows frozen-food volume up about 39% year-over-year in Q2 FY26, but that source is dated 2025-11-24 and is old [7]. **So when a proposal lands, check the product mix and packaging cost line; if packaging is above a fifth of other expenses, ask for the pass-through clause.**

## What has changed now
**The local demand signal is mixed and the data pack says Caution.** Andhra Pradesh GST collections fell 0.2% Apr-to-date against India's +6.1%, a 6.3 pp gap [D]. Electricity demand rose 18.1% Apr-to-date against India's +9.5% [D]. Nationally, bank credit grew 25.3% YoY against output of 5.1% [D]. **Credit is running far ahead of output, so pricing power is thin and lenders are competing for the same borrowers.** The Tirupati CII meet drew Rs 11,732 crore of MoUs across Tirupati, Chittoor, Annamayya, YSR Kadapa and SPSR Nellore, with 20,879 jobs expected [1][2]. **Those are proposals, not disbursements; treat them as pipeline, not proof.**

## Where to grow, and how to grow safely
**Pursue value-added dairy, frozen vegetables and ready-to-cook processors with named buyers and cold-chain assets in Sri City.** Avoid pure commodity edible-oil and gherkin traders; ICRA flags their margin volatility and policy exposure [9][10]. **Structure term loans against cold-chain capex only, with a moratorium matched to the commissioning date.** Take monthly stock statements, ageing of receivables and a quarterly raw-material price chart.

## Early-warning signs
**Watch the gap between revenue growth and EBITDA margin.** Milky Mist grew revenue 42% and still improved margin to 15.17% [4]; a borrower growing fast while margin slips is buying volume. **Watch packaging and power costs monthly; Dodla's 41.6% packaging jump shows how fast a cost line moves [6].** Watch GST filings against bank credits, and watch cold-storage capacity utilisation. **If utilisation falls below the level at sanction for two quarters, ask for the buyer list and reprice.**
